correctness.rationale: For any ordered induced seven-tuple w_i in C_n^p, cyclic positive gaps g_i sum to n. Each nonedge w_i-w_{i+3} forces 3-gap sums ≥p+1 and their complements >p; summing yields 3n≥7(p+1). Since a two-gap arc is smaller than a forbidden three-gap arc, adjacency of the index-distance-two pair forces each two-gap sum ≤p; summing gives 2n≤7p. Conversely w_j=⌊jn/7⌋ yields 1- and 2-step clockwise distances ≤⌈2n/7⌉≤p and 3-/4-step distances ≥⌊3n/7⌋≥p+1 in both directions, proving the iff interval for cyclic-order-preserving induced C7². The ordinary 3-cut complex of C7² has seven tetrahedral facets and collapses via 25 free-face pairs to S¹ (seed homotopy already Bayer et al Proposition 7.27). The link of the complement of this induced subset in the ambient ordinary 3-cut complex equals the seed cut complex. A pure shellable complex would have shellable links, whereas the pure 3-dimensional seed has nonzero H1; hence nonshellability. Independently exhausted seven-subsets for p=2..4; this only checks bounded cases, while the gap proof handles all p≥2.
